body:
# Highlights
* Shift Parallelism release
* [Arctic Inference with Shift Parallelism: The Fastest Open Source Inference System for Enterprise AI](https://www.snowflake.com/en/engineering-blog/arctic-inference-shift-parallelism/)

## What's Changed
* bump to v0.0.7 by @sfc-gh-jrasley in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/35
* update install instructions by @sfc-gh-jrasley in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/36
* Fix ParallelLMHead quantization by @Xiuyu-Li in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/39
* Reclaim `speculator_config` by  `vllm_config` before initializing the drafter. by @dtransposed in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/48
* Add seed and disable_by_batch_size in spec example by @sfc-gh-yewang in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/44
* force set seed if not explicitly specified  by @sfc-gh-yewang in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/45
* Fix crash in eager mode by @sfc-gh-yewang in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/56
* Warning message and disabling the plugin when vLLM V0 enabled.  by @dtransposed in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/57
* Spec model's TP on SP allocated GPUs by @sfc-gh-yewang in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/58
* Fix suffix decoding over model len limit by @sfc-gh-aqiao in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/61
* Integrate Dynasor to Arctic Inference by @GindaChen in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/31
* Introduce Shift Parallelism and integrate it with SwiftKV and Spec. Dec. by @sfc-gh-mhidayetoglu in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/66
* Add embedding optimizations by @sfc-gh-juyang in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/62
* Fix V1 check and non-shift mode by @sfc-gh-aqiao in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/71
* updating embedding readme by @sfc-gh-juyang in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/69
* update readme by @sfc-gh-yewang in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/68
* Fix for wheel build by @sfc-gh-mwyatt in https://github.com/snowflakedb/ArcticInference/pull/74
